clauses.reason: Sec. 2 provides that, notwithstanding any other Executive Order, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act applicable to the committees listed in Sec. 1 are performed by the head of the department or agency designated after each committee, in accordance with the regulations, guidelines and procedures of the Administrator of General Services. Sec. 3 provides that Sections 1 and 2 of Executive Order 14109 of September 29, 2023 are hereby superseded by sections 1 and 2 of this order. It is a one-time self-executing supersession, and Sec. 4 of the held original states that the order is effective September 30, 2025, so the command was performed on that date; the order's own registered clause is the source of the end. Nothing in the held evidence shows an earlier performance or a later reinstatement of Executive Order 14109 Secs. 1 and 2.

research_rationale:
EO 14354 (90 FR 48145) of September 29, 2025 continues twenty-two federal advisory committees until September 30, 2027 and assigns the Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for them to the designated departments. The held original was read in full and confirmed to be the order (number, date and subject agree with the register row). Sec. 3, which supersedes Secs. 1 and 2 of Executive Order 14109, is a one-time supersession performed on the order's effective date of 2025-09-30; the other thirty-one clauses are the continuance, the allocation of functions, the effective-date provision and the general provisions, whose only own-terms end (2027-09-30) is after the cutoff. No held instrument amends or revokes the order, and the bounded searches found only citations, so those clauses are carried as operative through 2026-10-14.
